meta.title: Marcin Kowalczyk — UX / Product Designer
meta.description: UX/UI designer focused on complex digital products, operational tools, and turning ambiguous problems into systems people can actually use.
nav.label: Main
hero.bio: Hi, I’m Marcin. I design complex digital products and help turn complicated problems into clear solutions.
cs.label: CASE STUDY
howIWork.heading: How I work
howIWork.1.text: I co-create research scenarios, build prototypes and observe sessions. I analyse GA and Clarity data myself.
howIWork.2.text: I start with a stakeholder workshop and check feasibility with developers throughout the project.
howIWork.3.text: I design to WCAG: contrast, typography, clear states and focus.
howIWork.4.text: I review builds on staging against the design, the design system and the user scenarios.
footer.credit: Designed and coded by Marcin Kowalczyk
